name: AutoCurr – Local Currency Converter
author: autocurrteam

sections.description:
Show prices in each reader’s local currency

Writing a Japan guide? A ticket might cost JPY 20,000. That yen price matters because it is what the traveler will pay, but a reader in the US, UK, Belgium, or Canada may want a familiar comparison.

AutoCurr keeps the original price visible and automatically adds the reader’s local currency beside it when a supported conversion is available. Enter the source price once; AutoCurr handles conversion and automatic exchange-rate updates.

AutoCurr is a WordPress currency converter built for prices inside regular posts and pages. No API key is required by default, no separate AutoCurr account is needed, and no WooCommerce is required. It does not process checkout or payments.

Getting Started

After installing and activating AutoCurr Free, add this shortcode to your content:

[autocurr amount="26" currency="EUR"]

Here, 26 is the actual source amount and EUR is its currency. You do not need to specify target currencies such as USD, GBP, or CAD. AutoCurr determines the visitor’s local currency automatically.

The original EUR 26 stays visible. Readers who already use EUR see the price once. When a supported different currency is detected and conversion is available, they see that amount alongside EUR 26.

That is it.

How it works

  1. Add the actual source price.
  2. AutoCurr determines the visitor’s local currency.
  3. The source price stays visible and the local conversion is added when available.
  4. AutoCurr keeps exchange-rate data updated automatically.

You choose which prices AutoCurr handles using the shortcode in Free or the visual workflow in Pro. It does not scan your site and replace every number. Once you mark a price, currency detection, conversion, and rate updates happen automatically.

AutoCurr Free includes

  • Automatic visitor currency detection
  • Automatic local currency conversion
  • Original source price remains visible
  • Broad currency support
  • Simple [autocurr] shortcode
  • Automatic exchange-rate updates
  • No API key required by default
  • No AutoCurr account required
  • Works in normal WordPress posts and pages
  • Source price remains visible if conversion is unavailable

Why keep the original currency?

If a hotel costs JPY 20,000, that is still the price the traveler will pay. AutoCurr keeps it and adds familiar context for the reader. You maintain one source price instead of manually typing and updating several conversions in USD, EUR, GBP, or CAD.

Want an easier publishing workflow?

AutoCurr Free includes complete automatic currency conversion. AutoCurr Pro is for publishers who work with prices regularly and want a faster publishing workflow and more control.

Instead of typing shortcodes, use Pro’s visual controls to insert, edit, and remove AutoCurr prices in Gutenberg/RichText. You can also select existing price text and convert it into an AutoCurr price after confirming the details.

  • Visual Gutenberg/RichText authoring
  • Convert selected text into localized prices
  • Reusable Price Library
  • Localized price ranges
  • Visitor currency switching
  • Global and per-price display controls
  • Localization rules
  • Manual exchange rates
  • Percentage markup
  • Daily exchange-rate refresh

Learn about AutoCurr Pro.

For help, visit the WordPress.org support forum or contact hello@autocurr.com.

External Services

AutoCurr uses Frankfurter v2 to retrieve reference exchange rates when a conversion is required and no fresh cached rate is available. Requests are made server-side and include the requested source and target currency codes. AutoCurr does not send price amounts, post content, or the visitor’s IP address to Frankfurter. As with any server request, Frankfurter can see the website server’s outbound IP address.

Frankfurter
Terms and privacy information

Site administrators can optionally configure Open Exchange Rates as a fallback when Frankfurter cannot return a rate. When enabled, AutoCurr sends the configured App ID and requests the provider’s USD-based rate table. It does not forward visitor IP addresses, price amounts or post content. Open Exchange Rates can see the website server’s outbound IP address. Both services receive an AutoCurr/version User-Agent.

Open Exchange Rates

Privacy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add Plugin.
  2. Search for “AutoCurr” and click Install Now.
  3. Activate AutoCurr.
  4. Add a price using [autocurr amount="26" currency="EUR"].
  5. View the published page to see the localized price when conversion is available.

Read the full documentation.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No. AutoCurr is designed for prices inside regular WordPress posts and pages. It does not modify WooCommerce product prices, checkout currencies, or payments.

Do I need an API key?

No API key is required by default. An optional fallback service can be configured by site administrators, as described under External Services.

Do readers need to choose their currency?

No. AutoCurr Free determines the visitor’s currency automatically, using supported hosting/CDN country information first and the browser’s regional locale as a fallback. Pro also offers visitor currency switching if you want to let readers choose manually.

How often are exchange rates updated?

Free updates exchange rates automatically. Successful rates are cached for 7 days. Pro offers daily exchange-rate refresh. New rates are fetched when a conversion is requested after the cached rates expire; these are not real-time rates.

What happens if AutoCurr cannot get a conversion?

The original price remains visible rather than showing an invented or incorrect conversion. This also applies when no supported visitor currency is found or JavaScript is unavailable.

Is AutoCurr only for travel sites?

No. Travel guides are a natural fit, but AutoCurr works for any publisher writing about prices for an international audience, including product reviews, buying guides, affiliate content, resource pages, and international publications.

Does AutoCurr track visitors?

AutoCurr Free contains no telemetry or analytics. Exchange-rate requests are made server-side, without forwarding visitor IP addresses. AutoCurr does not call an external geolocation service. See External Services for the information rate providers receive.
